risk_note: LINT-STYLE-web (规划/05 §3.11.3, D10-643 ⑧). New ESLint plugin lint/style (couli-style/: no-arbitrary-value, no-small-brand-text, no-numeric-style, no-hex-color, exemption-reason) for apps/h5 and apps/admin, .ts and .tsx; existing violations are recorded in lint/style/baseline.json with counts equal to the current ones (5 H5 arbitrary values, 188 admin numeric sizes left for DSX-105) and a processor reports a file only when its count exceeds the baseline, so the baseline can only shrink; exemptions need a reason. eslint.config.js (protected class 2) only gains the import and one config entry enabling the plugin, processor and rules (orchestrator checks per #16 / #24; no owner sign-off needed per the 11-06 06:11 note). Admin theme 14 / 8 / 16 read ui-tokens (values unchanged); the button height 36 stays a literal with TODO blocked on DSX-105 (orchestrator technical decision: no token exists). Selected pills in earnings-page, claim-form and invite-page use brand-emphasis on brand-subtle (≥ 4.5:1 light and dark), the invite link uses text-link. Non-funds. Rule tests written by an independent Claude in three rounds (round 2 the 36 decision, round 3 fixed a TypeError red reason in the test's own scanner); Claude spec-test review r1 pass (four S2 carried into the implementation constraints), round 3 incremental review pass; red on the local container (red/2; AWS runners off since D10-555). Implementation by Opus 5.5; local container browser green; verify-fast failed only on the ledger hash of CT-24zt fixed on main by #2469, so the orchestrator ran lint-style-web and h5-dark on the host (8 files, 27 tests green) and eslint over apps/h5 and apps/admin (0 problems); after rebasing on main the full verification is the required CI checks. Independent Claude money review r1 pass (no findings). Written by hand.
